categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in manufacturing and selling electronic components for communication devices, specializing in high-spec camera module parts such as Folded Zoom, OIS, and Auto Focus Actuators. It also produces vibration motors, PTC thermistors and heaters, BLDC motors for automotive applications, and other electronic parts. The business includes both domestic production and overseas manufacturing facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary magnetic engineering and semiconductor ceramic technologies, including bonded magnets, rare-earth sintered magnets, and PTC thermistors. It employs advanced manufacturing methods such as automated production for Folded Zoom actuators and integrated actuator modules combining OIS and AF functions. The firm also develops high-voltage dual independent control PTC heaters and brushless DC motors using slotless designs and magnetic brake technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global smartphone manufacturers requiring high-resolution camera modules, automotive companies for electric vehicle components, and manufacturers of consumer electronics like refrigerators and air conditioners. The company serves markets for mobile communication devices, automotive parts, and various electronic appliances, with a strong focus on premium smartphones and emerging automotive applications such as ADAS camera systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span South Korea (headquarters and multiple factories), Vietnam (two factories), China (Hui Zhou factory and investment in Qingdao graphite company), India (subsidiary), and the Kaesong Industrial Complex. The company exports over 80% of its products globally, targeting international markets primarily in Asia and beyond.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and supplier of critical electronic components and modules to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in the smartphone and automotive industries. It controls upstream raw material development for magnetic powders and downstream assembly of precision actuators and motors, positioning itself as a key tier-1 vendor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment (over 10% of sales) to develop next-generation high-value products such as Folded Zoom actuators, integrated OIS-AF-IRIS actuators, high-voltage PTC heaters for electric vehicles, and ADAS camera modules. The company emphasizes innovation in miniaturization, precision, and energy efficiency, collaborating with universities and research institutes to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of manufactured electronic components and modules, with over 87% from communication device parts and 12% from other parts like PTC heaters. Sales are conducted via order-based production with domestic and export channels, including local L/C and T/T payment terms. The company also benefits from licensing and technology sales related to its proprietary developments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not disclosed, the company holds a leading domestic position with some products enjoying monopolistic status in Korea and significant global market share. It competes in highly specialized segments such as camera actuators and vibration motors, leveraging proprietary technologies and cost advantages from overseas production to maintain competitiveness against global component suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2022, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 503 billion KRW, a 72% increase from the previous year, with total assets of about 693 billion KRW and equity of 380 billion KRW. Despite recent operating losses and net losses in 2022, the company has shown strong revenue growth driven by new customer acquisitions and expanded production capacity. It maintains a solid capital base and continues investing heavily in R&D and production facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary magnetic engineering and precision actuator technologies enabling ultra-compact, high-performance camera modules essential for high-resolution smartphone cameras. Its integrated actuator solutions and energy-efficient PTC heaters for electric vehicles offer unique features like dual independent heating control. The firm emphasizes quality, innovation, and cost competitiveness supported by in-house raw material development and global manufacturing footprint.
